title: Open source cards at the fold
brief: The three free projects where the hero meets the next section. The reader must get, in one look, that these are real tools they can use today, and which one is for them; the screenshot proves it is real, the domain says where to go.

variants.name: Index
variants.note: One dark panel, three rows like a table of contents: logo, the promise in large type, a small screenshot, the way out. Calm and editorial; gives up the screenshot as the hero of each card and drops the repeated "Open source" tag, since the title already says it.
variants.css: #open-source .oss-cycle{width:auto!important}#open-source .oss-cards{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:0;max-width:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.85rem;background:var(--void);overflow:hidden}#open-source .oss-cards>li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}#open-source .oss-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:12rem minmax(0,1fr) 13rem auto;grid-template-areas:'logo title show actions' 'logo text show actions' 'logo domain show actions';grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr;column-gap:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,3rem);align-items:start;padding:1.6rem 1.25rem 1.6rem 2rem;border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--void)}#open-source .oss-card:hover{transform:none;background:var(--surface)}#open-source .oss-card__head,#open-source .oss-card__body,#open-source .oss-card__foot{display:contents}#open-source .oss-card__tag{display:none}#open-source .oss-card__logo{grid-area:logo;height:2.1rem;margin-top:.15rem}#open-source .oss-card__title{grid-area:title;font-size:clamp(1.25rem,1.7vw,1.6rem);font-weight:560;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.15}#open-source .oss-card__title .oss-cycle{margin-top:0}#open-source .oss-card__text{grid-area:text;margin:.55rem 0 0;max-width:34em}#open-source .oss-card__domain{grid-area:domain;align-self:end;margin-top:1rem}#open-source .oss-card__show{grid-area:show;margin:0;align-self:center}#open-source .oss-card__actions{grid-area:actions;align-self:center}@media (max-width:1023px){#open-source .oss-cards{max-width:none}#open-source .oss-card{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;grid-template-areas:'logo actions' 'title title' 'text text' 'domain domain';grid-template-rows:auto;padding:1.25rem}#open-source .oss-card__show{display:none}#open-source .oss-card__logo{height:1.7rem;margin:0 0 1rem}#open-source .oss-card__actions{align-self:start}}

variants.name: Spotlight
variants.note: Loaders, the project the hero already calls new, gets a big card with its screenshot on lime; Skills and Blob sit beside it as compact cards with a thumbnail. One clear focal point, at the cost of the three being equals.
variants.css: #open-source .oss-cycle{width:auto!important}#open-source .oss-cards{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.45fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr}#open-source .oss-cards>li:nth-child(3){grid-column:1;grid-row:1/3}#open-source .oss-cards>li:nth-child(-n+2){grid-column:2}#open-source li:nth-child(3) .oss-card__title{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2vw,1.9rem);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1}#open-source li:nth-child(3) .oss-card__show::before{opacity:1}#open-source li:nth-child(3) .oss-card__show{border-color:transparent}#open-source li:nth-child(3) .oss-card__tag{border-color:var(--coleoni-green);color:var(--coleoni-green)}#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__head{height:3.4rem}#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__logo{height:1.45rem}#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 10.5rem;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;column-gap:1.25rem;padding:1rem 1.25rem}#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__title{grid-column:1}#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__text{grid-column:1;margin:.4rem 0 0;font-size:.85rem}#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__show{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3;margin:0;align-self:center}#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__foot{padding-block:.55rem}@media (max-width:1023px){#open-source .oss-cards{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-rows:none}#open-source .oss-cards>li:nth-child(n){grid-column:1;grid-row:auto}#open-source .oss-cards>li:nth-child(3){order:-1}}@media (max-width:520px){#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__body{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 7rem;column-gap:1rem}#open-source li:nth-child(-n+2) .oss-card__text{display:none}}

variants.name: Shelf
variants.note: Three short paper tiles, screenshot on the left, logo and promise on the right, domain underneath: all three fit above the fold and read in a second. Fastest to scan; the one-line description goes, and the light tiles pull the eye away from the headline.
variants.css: :root{--oss-drop:4.5rem}#open-source .oss-cycle{width:auto!important}#open-source .oss-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44% minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:'show logo' 'show title' 'show domain';grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto;column-gap:1.1rem;padding:.75rem;background:var(--paper);color:var(--void);border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.08)}#open-source .oss-card:hover{border-color:var(--coleoni-green)}#open-source .oss-card__head,#open-source .oss-card__body,#open-source .oss-card__foot{display:contents}#open-source .oss-card__tag,#open-source .oss-card__text,#open-source .oss-card__github,#open-source .oss-card__go{display:none}#open-source .oss-card__logo{grid-area:logo;height:1.35rem;margin:.55rem 0 .7rem}#open-source .oss-card__logo--blob{content:url(/brand/blob-dark.svg)}#open-source .oss-card__logo--loaders{content:url(/brand/loaders-dark.svg)}#open-source .oss-card__title{grid-area:title;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--void)}#open-source .oss-card__title .oss-cycle{margin-top:0}#open-source .oss-card__show{grid-area:show;margin:0;aspect-ratio:auto;height:100%;min-height:8.5rem;border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.06);background:#e4e6df}#open-source .oss-card__show img{object-position:20% 50%}#open-source .oss-card__domain{grid-area:domain;color:#4a4a4a;margin:.6rem 0 .35rem}#open-source .oss-card__domain::after{content:' ↗';color:#4A7300}#open-source .oss-card:hover .oss-card__domain{color:var(--void)}#open-source .oss-card__actions{display:none}@media (max-width:1023px){#open-source .oss-card{grid-template-columns:40% minmax(0,1fr)}#open-source .oss-card__show{min-height:7rem}}
